item.subject: maths
item.stem:
The diagram shows the given data for constructing $\triangle FGH$: included side $FG = 8\,\mathrm{cm}$ with $\angle F = 35^{\circ}$ and $\angle G = 55^{\circ}$.

One or more options may be correct. Which two claims belong in a correct construction plan?

options.A: Name the finished triangle as the included side $FG$ alone, and stop.
options.B: Draw $FG = 8\,\mathrm{cm}$; mark $35^{\circ}$ at $F$ and $55^{\circ}$ at $G$; the arms meet at $H$.
options.C: A triangle forms because $35^{\circ}+55^{\circ}=90^{\circ}$ leaves a positive third angle of $90^{\circ}$.
options.D: Copy the printed $8$ alone and treat that numeral as the finished triangle.
